# data.docker_images

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Lists the images in the provider's daemon image store, like `docker image ls` (`GET /images/json`), sorted by ID. The optional arguments are Engine API filters.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `all` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Also list intermediate images (`--all`). Default `false`. |
| `before` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only images created before this image (name or ID) (`before` filter). |
| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | sha256 of images_json. |
| `dangling` | `bool` | optional |  |  | `true` lists only untagged images, `false` only tagged ones (`dangling` filter). |
| `docker_server_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Docker Engine version from GET /version. |
| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion). |
| `ids` | `list(string)` | computed |  |  | IDs of the listed images, sorted. |
| `images` | `list(object)` | computed |  |  | The GET /images/json response as a nested object, field by field. |
| `images_json` | `string` | computed |  |  | The exact Engine API GET /images/json response as JSON. |
| `labels` | `map(string)` | optional |  |  | Only images carrying every one of these labels; an empty value matches any value (`label` filter). |
| `reference` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only images whose reference matches this pattern, e.g. `nginx` or `ghcr.io/org/*:1.*` (`reference` filter). |
| `since` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only images created after this image (name or ID) (`since` filter). |
| `until` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only images created before this time: a timestamp or a Go duration such as `24h` (`until` filter). |

## Example

```terraform
# Every tagged nginx image on the daemon (docker image ls).
data "docker_images" "nginx" {
  reference = "nginx"
  dangling  = false
}

output "nginx_image_ids" {
  value = data.docker_images.nginx.ids
}
```
